prompt:
Edit the supplied complete ORIGINAL clothing/legs diffuse UV atlas 6830 to a higher-resolution texture with the same restrained hand-painted game style. The reference is original128x128 enlarged nearest8x to1024x1024, entire canvas. Keep the square frame, all original UV field bounds, the same exact palette relationships, positions and physical scale of the painted pattern. No crop, padding, letterbox, rotation, new seams or atlas rearrangement.

Source-count constraints verified before this request: exactly 3 existing major color fields, with 1 gray upper-left field, 1 flat skin-colored lower-left field, and 1 large dark-brown right field. The gray/skin vertical border is native x55; their horizontal junction is native y81. The right brown field continues edge to edge from native x55 through127 and y0 through127. There are 0 independently readable buttons and 0 independently readable buckles here, and 0 new discrete hardware is allowed. This is not a claimed regular print pattern: keep the original irregular gray low-contrast block-like painted wash and its exact broad source phase/scale, without interpreting the pixels into a plaid, grid, individual sole-tread blocks, laces, eyelets, straps, buckles or added anatomy. Preserve uncertainty rather than concretizing unclear source patches.

Improve only the existing soft painted transitions and very fine subtle paint grain at the original material scale. Keep the right brown fabric/leather UV field dark and plain, with only the same very broad original shadow patches and the faint source diagonal dark sweep near the bottom-right at its exact location. Do not sharpen it into a new crease, strap or seam. Keep the upper-left gray field with the same softly washed, indistinct source patches, neither a new crisp checker pattern nor metallic hardware. Keep the lower-left skin-color field a flat soft painted ochre/tan wash, only the same broad highlight/shadow from the original, no skin pores, anatomy, freckles, wrinkles, beautification or photographic texture. Preserve the original subtle dark separators and boundary tones, no outlined rim or bevel. All actual source pixels are alpha255 including dark black-looking texels: the entire canvas remains fully opaque, no holes or transparent areas.

Do not add explicit folds, heavy fabric weave, hatching, coarse noise, curls, ornaments, embroidery, repeated grains, glossy highlights, rivets, buttons, text, symbols or objects. Do not brighten the brown field relative to the gray or skin fields. Do not shift their hue hierarchy. Produce only this complete unchanged-layout material atlas, with fine soft painting at higher resolution.
